items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: You heard of Zooty Singleton? Well that's his wife, Charlie Pest's sister, his wife.

ctx.x: Charlie had a movie called Gig, that's a gig band.

the suburb. He played. Sometimes he had two or three bands out at night. All around St. Louis and the suburb. Of course we were in Illinois. He was very great. People would all be great.
